item.description: From boot up to complete in 4 hours and 45 minutes. That's the new time record set by our Wet Dress Rehearsal operators at Launch Complex 1 for our next mission. The launch window for "Night Owls Never Sleep" for synspective with our 101st Electron rocket opens: 🚀 1:00 pm NZDT, Nov 27 🚀 00:00 UTC, Nov 27 🚀 9:00 am JST, Nov 27 🚀 7:00 pm ET, Nov 26 🚀 4:00 pm PT, Nov 26

item.description: Step inside the Neutron test campaign with the Thrust Module and Stage 2 at Launch Complex 3 🚀 ⚙️ These campaigns are all about verifying the hardware, the ground systems, and operational procedures, bringing Neutron one step closer to flight.

item.title: ESCAPADE’s view of Earth as Blue and Gold pass by on their way to Mars. Two week…
item.description: ESCAPADE’s view of Earth as Blue and Gold pass by on their way to Mars. Two weeks ago, the Rocket Lab-built spacecraft completed powered flybys of Earth two days apart. About three hours later, one spacecraft captured this farewell view of our planet from 38,500 miles away. Here are a few images from the next stage of the escapade mars mission for NASA and ucbssl. 📸 NASA/ucbssl/NAU/RocketLab

item.description: ESCAPADE’s view of Earth as it passes by on the way to Mars. Two weeks ago, the Rocket Lab-built Blue & Gold spacecraft completed powered flybys of Earth two days apart, and are now on their way to Mars. Here are a few images from this next stage of the escapade mars mission for NASA and ucbssl. 📸 NASA/ucbssl/NAU/RocketLab
